content: The district has a heating peak of 30 MW and a cooling peak of 10 MW. The reservoir is at a midpoint of 2,500 m, with a thickness of 100 m, and a temperature gradient of 30 C/km from a base temperature of 12 C. The brine has a density of 1,030 kg/m³, a viscosity of 0.40 mPa·s, and a gas content of 0.8 Nm³/m³ (80% CH4, 20% CO2). The hard limits include doublets of 1-3, flow per doublet of 50-300 m³/h, brine cooling maximum of 40 C, pump efficiency of 0.7, production equals injection, geothermal days per doublet maximum of 330, heating supply temperature of 100 C, cooling supply temperature of 20 C, and demand met days of 365. The missing inputs include heating return temperature (assumed 50 C), cooling return temperature (not given), outage scheduling (not confirmed), and costs (not modelled). The tools available are simulate_doublet and simulate_year.
